sloka: स तत् श्रुत्वा वचः क्रूरम् निह्श्वसन् शोक कर्शितः ।नाशकत्तीव्रमायासमकर्तुम् भगवानृषिः ॥२-६४-२१॥
transliteration: sa tat śrutvā vacaḥ krūram nihśvasan śoka karśitaḥ ।nāśakattīvramāyāsamakartum bhagavānṛṣiḥ ॥2-64-21॥

translations.english: The venerable sage heard my cruel words about the sinful act and was not able to seriously react. (He was stunned).
